name: NTR Tsuma no Choukyou Kiroku
source:
She stepped out one day and didn't return.
Her husband (protagonist) checked her things and discovered a DVD that he'd never seen before. It was a visual journal of his wife being violated by his best friend.
He immediately went to the friend's house, but it was already too late.
A netorare/cuckoldry story!!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096034.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
她某天出门后就没有回来。她的丈夫（主人公）检查了她的物品，发现了一张从未见过的DVD。那是他的妻子被最好的朋友侵犯的视觉记录。他立即前往朋友家，但为时已晚。一个NTR/绿帽故事！！
